chunks.text: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase.
International delivery normally takes between 7 and 10 business days.
Full-time employees receive 15 days of annual leave each calendar year.
Production access requires multi-factor authentication and manager approval.
客户可以在购买商品后的三十天内提交退款申请。
国际订单通常需要七到十个工作日完成配送。
正式员工每个自然年享有十五天年假。
访问生产环境必须启用多因素认证并获得主管批准。
Digital subscriptions can be cancelled for a full refund within 7 days.
Domestic express delivery normally arrives within 2 business days.
Independent contractors do not receive paid annual leave.
Development environment access requires team lead approval but not MFA.
数字订阅可在开通后的七天内取消并获得全额退款。
国内加急订单通常在两个工作日内送达。
独立承包人员不享受带薪年假。
开发环境访问需要团队负责人批准，但不强制多因素认证。
